methods.label: Use the nearest and farthest radial distances
methods.explanation: The shortest distance is \(OP-5=3\), so \(OP=8\). The longest distance is \(OP+5=13\).

needsNewNodes.name: Farthest distance from a point to a circle
needsNewNodes.description: For a circle with center O and radius r>0, the maximum distance from P to a circle point is OP+r. If P differs from O, it is attained at the radial endpoint opposite P; if P=O, every circle point attains the maximum r.
needsNewNodes.reason: The catalog's nearest-point node covers only the minimum distance. No existing node specifically covers the maximum-distance formula and where equality is attained.
